sources.entry: python-barcode - Create barcodes in Python with no extra dependencies.

summary.one_liner: python-barcode is a Python library for generating barcodes, with SVG output needing no external dependencies and image output (e.g. PNG) requiring Pillow.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes python-barcode as a simple way to create barcodes in Python. SVG file generation has no external dependencies. Generating image files such as PNGs requires Pillow. The README says it supports Python 3.11 to 3.15. It shows an example EAN-13 barcode image. Full documentation is hosted externally, and the docs can be built locally with make -C docs html. The README does not list specific barcode symbologies or API details beyond these points.
use_cases: produce SVG barcodes without extra libraries
make PNG barcode images with Pillow
add barcodes to labels or product records
how_to_run: pip install Pillow (only needed for image output such as PNG)
make -C docs html (build the documentation locally)
notable: No external dependencies for SVG output
Pillow only needed for raster image formats like PNG
Documentation is published separately and can be built locally with Sphinx-style make target
caveats: README does not describe the full list of supported barcode formats
Full documentation lives outside the README
